DPR 1 and DPR 2 at identical CSS size
compatible Original and Candy Grass, Forest and Mountain variants
all owner treatments, selection and fog boundaries

terrain-fertile-ground.visualFindings: Accepted after source, native, enlarged, minimum 0.625x, DPR1/2, hidden/revealed, four-owner, selection, fog, Original/Candy Grass, 8x8 repetition, and dense-map review. The 256x296 straight-alpha candidate has compact alpha x56..200 y144..222 at anchor 128,222: one low matte irregular dark-loam patch with two small sprouts. It remains distinct from bright Fruit, Farm-like rows or structures, ownership borders, and the diamond selection overlay; it has no halo, clipping, noise, text, status mark, or terrain-sized mass.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Rejected after source, native, enlarged, and 0.625x inspection: alpha x52..203 y112..222 is 151x110 and reaches the hard-limit top; the three large outlined mounds plus tall sprouts read as a planted garden mass rather than the required low persistent uncultivated marker. Silhouette must be shorter, quieter, and kept near preferred x56..200 y142..230 without Farm/selection/ownership cues.

Rejected after source, native, enlarged, and 0.625x inspection: alpha x39..217 y112..222 is 178x110, wider than the preferred marker footprint and again reaches the hard-limit top. Pale glossy fused lobes read as icing or arranged plots rather than dark uncultivated loam. Regenerate with dark matte earth, subtler sprouts, and deterministic preferred-bounds fitting.

terrain-stone.visualFindings: Accepted after source, native, enlarged, minimum 0.625x, DPR1/2, hidden/revealed, four-owner, selection, fog, Original/Candy Mountain, 8x8 repetition, and dense-map review. The 256x296 straight-alpha candidate has low alpha x84..171 y142..222 at anchor 128,222: exactly three softly irregular weathered blue-slate/gray boulders. Rounded natural silhouettes remain distinct from angular gold Ore crystals, sharp Mountain peaks, cut Quarry blocks, and selection/status marks; there is no halo, clipping, tool, building cue, noise, or terrain-sized mass.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Rejected after source, native, enlarged, and 0.625x inspection: compact alpha x75..181 y142..222 passes preferred geometry and is distinct from Ore crystals, but three squared pieces with pale flat tops and planar vertical sides read as quarried/cut masonry or a completed Quarry. Stone must be naturally weathered low boulders with irregular rounded silhouettes and no manufactured faces.

terrain-road-material.visualFindings: Accepted as the quiet raw material input only after source, native, enlarged, minimum 0.625x, DPR1/2, four-edge, four-owner, selection, fog, Original/Candy Grass/Forest/Mountain, 8x8 repetition, and dense coexistence review. The 256x148 straight-alpha candidate is a deterministic diamond-masked uniform matte warm gray-brown field with alpha x14..239 y1..147 at anchor 128,74. It contains no line, track, pebble, route, centerline, edge, intersection, direction, baked neighbor layout, halo, or noise; Fruit, GAME/Forest, Ore/Mountain, Mine, Camp, Wall, and units remain legible. Orthogonal mask composition remains deferred to phg.12.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Rejected after source, native, enlarged, 0.625x, four-edge, owner, dense-map, and 8x8 inspection: the two long parallel blue strokes read as lane/track markings and bake a strong direction into the source. The pale tan full diamond dominates repetition and mixed contexts rather than acting as quiet neutral mask-ready material. Regenerate as a uniform low-saturation warm gray-brown field with no internal route, line, stroke, pebble, or directional cue.
